title: Align route chip baseline
author: Budi Santoso
text: Move the route chip label down one pixel in the compact shipment row. No query or permission changes. Before and after screenshots are attached to the review.

title: Fix chart legend spelling
author: Linh Nguyen
text: Correct Singpore in the region legend. The underlying region key remains ap-sg. Tomoko spotted this in a screenshot that has apparently been in three board decks.

title: Name replay counter correctly
author: Pranav Menon
text: Rename replayed_parcels to replayed_events in the internal diagnostic. The counter already counts events. No change to replay behavior or approval handling.

title: Fix long depot name clipping
author: Budi Santoso
text: Allow the depot name to wrap in the narrow drawer. The longest fixture is Bandar Seri Begawan North. The row height grows naturally; there is no hardcoded country-specific width.

title: Repair dashboard panel link
author: Haruto Sato
text: Point the queue-age panel to the tenant-filtered view. The old link dropped the tenant variable but the alert query itself was scoped correctly. The panel title is unchanged.

title: Clarify Kestrel fixture names
author: Chen Wei
text: Name the partner fixture files by response type instead of capture order. Nothing in this commit changes the polling slots or retry horizon. The fixtures are fabricated examples maintained by integrations.

title: Fix token metric label
author: Pranav Menon
text: Correct the metric help text to say tenant-scoped token. The stored key and its expiry are unchanged. This was a documentation typo in the dashboard, not an isolation bug.

title: Revert dispatch acknowledgement batching
author: Mei Tan
text: Revert 8c31a7: restore per-tenant acknowledgement flush. The grouped flush can wait behind a tenant with an expired carrier token. INC-042 links the queue trace and rollback timings. This commit restores the old path without changing the manifest schema.

title: Add rollback trace link
author: Haruto Sato
text: Add the rollback trace URL to the incident index. The index previously linked only the forward rollout. No workflow scheduling or deployment behavior changes in this commit.

title: Rename partner quota chart
author: Chen Wei
text: Change the chart legend from workers to concurrent requests. These were always requests, not server instances. The plotted values and the connector limit remain untouched.

title: Trim duplicate trace label
author: Pranav Menon
text: Remove a repeated tenant label from the internal trace display. The exporter still carries the tenant field once. No payload body is added to logs.

title: Fix range label spacing
author: Budi Santoso
text: Use a nonbreaking space between the ETA number and its unit. The predicted range and observed timestamp remain unchanged. The Japanese layout screenshot now matches the design file.

title: Repair archive navigation links
author: Thao Tran
text: Fix the onboarding index links to the incident archive and the Route Lens checkpoint notes. This commit repairs navigation only; it does not rewrite the older policy snapshots.
